same: Is the work `new` asks for the same work as this ticket, so that doing one would do the other? Ticket: {candidate}
part: Would `new` fit inside this open ticket as one more step or ask of it, rather than as work of its own? Ticket: {candidate}
ships: Does this shipped change already do what `ticket` asks for? Shipped change: {candidate}
replaces: Does this shipped change make `ticket` unnecessary by solving its problem a different way? Shipped change: {candidate}
duplicate: Is `ticket` asking for the same work as this other ticket, so that doing one would do the other? Other ticket: {candidate}
tries: Would a person checking that `ticket`'s change works in the app use this action while trying it? Action: {candidate}
shows: Does this line from `ticket` say what a person should see or be able to do once the change works? Line: {candidate}
unfinished: Does `ticket.latest`, the newest lines added to the ticket, say the work was found wrong, broken or unfinished after it shipped, or that it continues in another ticket?
